source_basis: game-level raw files plus summary-only multi-seed files where exact games per condition are reported
overlap_caveat: R4 and R5 share source games; seat-order rows include deterministic duplicates; summary-only ten-player stages may overlap configuration families.
final_reporting_rule: Report stage-specific counts and sample units, not one grand independent N.

source_basis: matched_set_id counts in R3, R4/R5, ML live stages, seat-order-neutral, and R6.1 modules
overlap_caveat: Matched sets are defined within stage and cannot be pooled without stage clustering.
final_reporting_rule: Use stage-level matched-set counts for formal contrasts.

source_basis: R4 and R5 player payoff files each have 40000 rows over the same payoff validation source games.
overlap_caveat: R4 and R5 are derived from the same player-game units.
final_reporting_rule: Use R5 for final risk table; use R4 for ledger validation.

source_basis: R4 payoff event rows and R6.1 role-action/vote event logs; R3 belief updates counted separately.
overlap_caveat: Event rows are nested within games and cannot be treated as independent outcomes.

source_basis: R2 utterance dataset plus R3 live speech events.
overlap_caveat: Speech event rows are nested inside games and templates.
final_reporting_rule: Use for BoW feature and speech-signal analysis, not game outcome N.

source_basis: R3 vote/belief rows and R6.1 villager vote rows.
overlap_caveat: Rows are nested in games and policies.

source_basis: BoW and ML rollout/counterfactual diagnostic tables.
